articles.title: Amazon Has a Sale on Magic: The Gathering Booster Boxes Even Before Black Friday Kicks Off
articles.summary: Has Magic: The Gathering ever been as popular as it is right now? It feels like the long-running card game is having a bit of a moment in terms of bringing fresh players in via its ever-growing roster of Universes Beyond crossover properties.
body: Rightly or wrongly, that means there are more people looking to build collections, whether they’re playing or collecting the cards, and it just so happens that Amazon has rolled out some price cuts on Play Booster Boxes - including the Star Trek one at 26% off just weeks before it even launches.

It’s worth reminding you that these are Play Booster Boxes, as opposed to Collector Booster ones. Aside from a massive difference in price, Collector Boosters are where you’ll find the most valuable cards in each set. With that caveat out of the way, here are the best Play Booster Box deals we’ve found so far.

Sure, that Star Trek deal is great, but it’s not the only Universes Beyond property seeing a price cut. In fact, you can find discounts on both Marvel sets, The Hobbit, and Avatar: The Last Airbender.
If you’re desperate for the new Darkhold Destiny set announced for next year, then good news: You can save on both the Marvel Spider-Man and Super Heroes Play Booster Boxes.

articles.title: After The BioWare Shutdown, Mass Effect Spiritual Successor Exodus Gets A New Look
articles.summary: In the wake of the news that EA has closed down BioWare and ended development on Mass Effect 5, Archetype Entertainment—co-founded by former BioWare devs Chad Robertson, James Ohlen, and Drew Karpyshyn—has given players a brand-new look at its upcoming title, a very Mass-Effecty sci-fi RPG called…
body: Specifically, Archetype has revealed a visual rework of its male player-character model. When GameSpot previewed Exodus in late August, the male version of protagonist Jun Aslan could be seen sporting a five-o'-clock shadow and very different bone structure. Now, he has a whole new face. In a new video uploaded to Archetype's YouTube channel today, Archetype general manager Chad Robertson showed off male-Jun's new look, which he explained is a result of player feedback.

"We've seen your conversations and feedback over the last few months around our male Jun character model," Robertson said. "We've been listening, and we take that feedback seriously. We've continued to refine Jun as we've worked on him and the rest of the game."
Archetype hasn't yet revealed Jun's female character model, but the devs say her reveal is on the way.

"Is FemJun on your mind?" a new post on the official Exodus website asks. "Ours too! And we’re happy to say yes, she’s coming... soon™. We’ve got something special cooking for her reveal, and we think it’ll be worth the wait."

articles.title: Young Sheldon Star Annie Potts Says She Was a ‘Little Sad’ About Jim Parsons Cameo as 'Mean and Unchanged' Sheldon in Show's Finale
articles.summary: Annie Potts, who portrayed a younger version of Sheldon’s Meemaw on Young Sheldon, revealed how she felt about the show’s finale, disagreeing with how adult Sheldon remained "mean and unchanged" in Parsons' finale cameo.
body: The end of Young Sheldon — the seven-season-long Big Bang Theory Spinoff show — was rife with drama. Its abrupt ending was reportedly revealed to cast members in a Zoom call, with Potts saying she felt “blindsided” by the decision and went "full Meemaw” on the series’ producers.

She elaborated on these feelings in a book authored by Jessica Radloff titled Young Sheldon: The (Juicier-Than-Meemaw’s-Brisket) Inside Story of the Hit Comedy, where she described her reaction to Jim Parson’s cameo at the end of the final episode as a grown-up Sheldon.
According to Radloff’s book, Potts was “a little sad” about how Sheldon remained “mean and unchanged” as a character despite all the events of the prequel series.

While most of the cast reportedly felt similarly burnt by the situation, Young Sheldon himself, Iain Armitage, said he was probably the only member who was actually happy that the show was finally over.

articles.title: Tom Skerritt Dies: Alien and Top Gun Actor Was 93
articles.summary: Tom Skerritt, the rugged, mustachioed actor best known to IGN readers for his roles in Top Gun and Alien, passed away from natural causes on Wednesday at the age of 93. “We are heartbroken by his loss,” Skerritt’s family said in a statement provided to The Hollywood Reporter.
body: “While the world knew Tom through his remarkable acting career, we knew him for his humor, curiosity, wisdom, generosity and the love he brought into our lives. He cared deeply about imagination, creativity, storytelling, service, veterans, the natural world and helping others find and share their own voices.”

Skerritt first gained acclaim as a film actor in director Robert Altman’s 1970 comedy M*A*S*H, where he played surgeon Duke Forrest, one of the few characters not included in the later classic TV series adaptation.
Other notable films of Skerritt’s in the 1970s include Harold and Maude, The Turning Point, Fuzz, Thieves Like Us, and Cheech & Chong’s Up in Smoke.

During the 1980s, Skerritt had roles in films such as The Dead Zone, Wisdom, SpaceCamp, Poltergeist III, and Steel Magnolias. But the role from that decade Skerritt best came to be remembered for is Commander Mike "Viper" Metcalf in 1986’s Top Gun. As the Commanding Office of the Top Gun program, Viper had to keep hot shot US Navy fighter pilots like Tom Cruise’s Maverick and Val Kilmer’s Iceman in check.

articles.title: GTA 6’s New TV Trailer Is A Bit Different, See It For Yourself
articles.summary: GTA 6 's marketing push is ramping up substantially, and that includes with TV commercials. Eagled-eyes fans have discovered that the new GTA 6 TV spots actually contain some extended sequences, but just barely.
body: For starters, a 30-second TV spot cuts out the steamy shower scenes with Jason and Lucia from the launch trailer. While the shower scenes are gone in this edit, the new TV spot has a slightly longer shots of an airplane sequence and another with Jason and Lucia standing next to their car.

Jason playfully nudges Lucia, and in the TV spot, she nearly topples to the ground. The Xbox logo was also removed, presumably due to Rockstar's reported promotional deal with Sony. You can check out the comparison below ( via IGN ).

A 90-second version, meanwhile, includes the shower scenes, along with the slightly longer sequences seen in the 30-second version. If you saw these TV spots recently, you might not have even noticed any of these changes, but GTA 6 fan accounts are extremely dedicated and never miss anything.

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and, yes, Xbox Series X|S, even though the TV ads for the game don't tell you that. Rockstar's marketing push for the game also includes real-life Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell restaurants where you can buy GTA-branded food.

articles.title: Alienware's Outstanding 32" 4K 240Hz Quantum-Dot OLED Gaming Monitor Drops to an All-Time Low
articles.summary: One of Alienware's highest-end gaming monitors is down to the lowest price this year. Ahead of Black Friday, Dell has lowered the price of the 32" Alienware AW3225QF 4K QD OLED gaming monitor to $779.99 with free shipping.
body: The Alienware AW3225QF is one of few Dell monitors that combines a 4K resolution with an OLED panel. This monitor incorporates Samsung's QD OLED technology; QD OLED panels are brighter than traditional OLED panels while maintaining near infinite response time, contrast ratio, and black levels that OLEDs are generally known for. The Alienware AW3225QF is HDR True Black 400 certified with up to 1,000 nits of peak brightness. It also boasts a factory calibrated 99.3% DCI-P3 color range, 1700R curve, 240Hz refresh rate, and G-Sync certification.

Connectivity-wise, the AW3225QF has two HDMI 2.1 ports (one with eARC) and one DisplayPort 1.4 port, all of which are capable of 4K at up to 240Hz. There are also a couple of USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports for attaching peripherals and a single USB Type-C port for charging. Dell backs this monitor up with a three-year warranty that includes burn-in protection.
points: One of Alienware's highest-end gaming monitors is down to the lowest price this year.

articles.title: I’m Getting Very Worried About Skate Following EA Layoffs
articles.summary: Publisher Electronic Arts recently slashed 400 roles across its company, which resulted in the shuttering of legendary RPG studio BioWare. But also impacted by the layoffs was Skate developer Full Circle, and now I'm growing increasingly worried about the future of a franchise I waited so long to…
body: Part of EA's latest round of layoffs on October 21 included cutting an unspecified number of staffers to create a "very clear roadmap" that leads to a "healthier and more sustainable business." Then, as VGC noted on the same day, "many" of the developers at Full Circle are gone. This includes artists Brendan Vermeltfoort and Will Granda, seasonal creative director John Epler, and senior designers Adam Martinazzi and David Milne--all of whom posted the unfortunate news on LinkedIn.

It's always a bummer when talented developers lose their jobs at the hands of corporate greed, but this one stings for me personally. As a big Skate girlie, I was so stoked for the franchise to make a comeback, and even more stoked to get my hands on the game in September 2025.

articles.title: WoW: Forever Is Keeping Its Secrets Close To The Chest
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players may have searched its beta with a fine-toothed comb, but Blizzard said there are still plenty of secrets waiting to be found come launch and beyond.
body: In a new WoW: Forever Podcast dedicated to the end of the beta, Blizzard made clear it's keeping many of the game's surprises close to its chest. Senior game designer Josh Greenfield said Blizzard had disabled some items and secrets for the beta. He gave an example of a new torch item that was originally turned off for the beta's first week, but later enabled to test out Forever's new lighting and fog tech. He said players can expect more of those types of surprises.

"There's definitely some secrets and stuff that we had turned off," Greenfield said when asked about still to be discovered secrets in the level 1-30 zones. "There's going to be things to discover that we didn't surface, suffice to say that."

Forever's beta had a maximum level of 30, meaning there is still a huge chunk of the game, including new zones, quests, dungeons, and raids, players haven't fully explored yet. When asked about items like a newly discovered sword in the beta that could potentially enable new playstyles, like a melee-focused "Battle Mage", Greenfield opted not to elaborate further.
points: World of Warcraft: Forever players may have searched its beta with a fine-toothed comb, but Blizzard said there are still plenty of secrets waiting to be found come launch and beyond.

articles.title: 'Mass Effect Universe' Leak Promised What Fans Have Waited Decades For
articles.summary: If fans were already sad about BioWare closing down, they're shattered after watching the leaked trailer for Mass Effect Universe. Sure, the trailer was short and a little cheesy — but it could have also signaled a return to form for the stagnant franchise.
body: Because the trailer was leaked, and the game was canceled, we can't judge how well the footage reflected the final vision. Fans were happy to see a familiar face in Liara T'Soni, but they were especially thrilled at the prospect of new buddies. In particular, series devotees were intrigued by the prominent appearance of a male Quarian throughout the trailer. The helmeted alien could well have been the series' first-ever male Quarian star.

So far, the series has only featured a single female Quarian, Tali'Zorah, as a recruitable character. Yet as much as the fandom loves Tali, people were ready to stop arguing over what the nomadic alien should actually look like. Plus, fans have been begging for a male Quarian for ages now, as evidenced by this Reddit post from nine years ago. At the time, some people were skeptical Mass Effect might ever pull it off.

"The population of the Citadel is almost as much as the entire Quarian race," one Mass Effect fan argued. "Considering you have races with populations of tens or possibly hundreds of billions, the Quarians are a footnote in the galactic population."
points: If fans were already sad about BioWare closing down, they're shattered after watching the leaked trailer for Mass Effect Universe.

articles.title: BioWare Deserved Better
articles.summary: EA shut down BioWare and laid off its remaining employees, ending the Mass Effect studio's three-decade run as the premiere RPG developer.
body: ​ The writing may have been on the wall, but that didn’t make the news any easier to stomach.

On Wednesday, Electronic Arts shut down BioWare, one of the most storied video game studios around. It was known for developing landmark fantasy and science-fiction RPGs throughout its 30 years of operation. Its remaining employees were laid off as part of around 400 job cuts at EA. The next Mass Effect, colloquially called Mass Effect 5, was canceled.

It’s an unceremonious end to a studio that was once at the forefront of choice-based, narrative-focused RPGs. The hundreds of employees who worked on its games over the years brought whole galaxies to life, filling them with beloved characters. Most importantly, BioWare series like Mass Effect and Dragon Age created spaces for players to feel represented and included. It’s not a stretch to say these games changed, or even saved, lives. BioWare’s games are art, and the power that art can have on an individual cannot be quantified.
points: EA shut down BioWare and laid off its remaining employees, ending the Mass Effect studio's three-decade run as the premiere RPG developer.

articles.title: A new Fallout 4 mod adds an entire town, but more importantly, it lets you join a gang
articles.summary: There's nothing I like more in a Fallout game then stumbling across some weird little settlement filled with oddball characters. So when I saw that this mod for Fallout 4 added a whole new town called Detour that's built on top of an overpass near Bedford Station, that was an instant download.
body: Better yet, the mod features new quests and over a dozen new characters voiced by real people—no AI was used!

But there's something better than that, even. I was delighted to discover that the town of Detour has its own gang. It's a small gang, sure: the overpass Detour is built on isn't particularly big and the town itself is pretty tiny, so there's not a whole lot of room for different factions to spring up. But that doesn't stop the members of the Detour Degens from occupying one little corner of the town where they hang out in matching jackets, smoking cigs, chugging from beer bottles, and looking tough.
Sort of. Look, the Detour Degens are no Tunnel Snakes, that's for sure. But they live on an overpass. They're doing their best.

There are a few different types of missions you can do to raise your reputation with the town of Detour, and besides helping out the sheriff with bounties and recovering stolen goods for a few of the merchants, you can also get in good with the gang. The two members of the Degens I met told me that the third member, their leader, was locked up and they wanted me to spring him.

articles.title: Half-Life 3 Rumors Reignite After Valve Employee Lets Codename Slip
articles.summary: It's been two decades since we last checked in on Gordon Freeman in Half-Life 2: Episode Two, with the promise of a third Half-Life game languishing for an absurdly long time.
body: The latest morsel about the long-rumored existence of Half-Life 3 comes after years of leaks about a game codenamed "HLX." One Valve employee just casually dropped the name HLX during a gaming convention this week, restarting the rumor mill.

At this week's GameSoundCon, a game music and sound design conference in Burbank, California, Valve composer Mike Morasky appeared on a panel with sound designers David Feise and Carlye Nyte. Their talk, titled "Valve’s Approach to an Open and Flexible Audio Engine," was meant to discuss Valve's Source 2 audio engine and extensible open systems. What most people will take away from that talk is that Morasky let slip Half-Life 3 's supposed codename HLX in a public forum, seemingly to the chagrin of one of his panelists.
points: It's been two decades since we last checked in on Gordon Freeman in Half-Life 2: Episode Two, with the promise of a third Half-Life game languishing for an absurdly long time.

articles.title: 'Clayface' Officially Sets Up Another Iconic Batman Villain in the DC Universe
articles.summary: Back in the summer of 2025, Clayface was filming in Liverpool. Photos from the set revealed a reference to another, far more famous Batman villain. One featured a wall with graffiti on it, and among the different tags was one that read “The Jokers.” That led to some speculation about Joker’s…
body: Because “Jokers” is plural, some thought it could be a reference to a DC Comics storyline from 2020, which introduced the idea that instead of one Joker, there are three: the clown, the criminal, and the comedian. That would explain away any personality inconsistencies between varying depictions of the character over 80 years. Others thought “The Jokers” could be a reference to the Joker gang, which is generally portrayed as a gang of street criminals who idolize, and dress like, the Joker. Versions of the gang were featured in Batman Begins as well as The Batman. Some thought it was proof that the Joker himself would appear in Clayface.
Having seen Clayface, I know the answer to these queries, and I can share that there are way more Joker references in this movie.

So, no, the Joker is not in Clayface, much less three of him, nor does the Joker gang appear, but there are a number of references to him. To start off, I’m really not sure if this graffiti even made it into the movie, as it's certainly never focused on, though it may be at the very end of the film, hidden in the background, if anywhere.
points: Back in the summer of 2025, Clayface was filming in Liverpool.
Photos from the set revealed a reference to another, far more famous Batman villain.
One featured a wall with graffiti on it, and among the different tags was one that read “The Jokers.

articles.title: Smash Bros. director Masahiro Sakurai thinks gen-AI will cause a surge of unoriginal games, but says human creativity can't be replicated
articles.summary: Masahiro Sakurai has spoken about the pitfalls of generative AI use in game development, saying that while he believes the technology will result in a surge of unoriginal video games, human creativity - such as that shown by designers like Ico's Fumito Ueda - can't be replicated.
body: In an interview with Japanese news outlet Denfaminicogamer, Sakurai was asked about his time judging for the Game Designers Awards (a role he recently retired from) and his thoughts on the massive increase of game releases since the awards began. In 2010, 275 games were published on Steam, whereas more than 19,000 released this year.

"19,000 is amazing, but I think that number will increase even more from now on," Sakurai said (as translated from Japanese using Google Translate). "I'm sure of it. That's because AI will increase the number. However, I think most of them will become 'unprofitable titles'. There are too many to keep track of, and it's impossible to understand them all.

"When it comes to things created with AI... or things mass-produced with poor quality, I think most of them will simply be reproductions of systems seen in various other games. I think there are already a lot of those now."

articles.title: Epic announces game jam where you have to use AI, then walks back the requirement
articles.summary: Unreal Engine maker Epic Games is running a game jam in November with thousands of dollars in prizes up for grabs. Contrary to so many art contests which ban the use of AI, participants in Epic's event are highly encouraged to use AI.
body: The theme of the 2026 Epic AI MegaJam will be revealed on November 11, and participating individuals and teams will then have from November 12–15 to produce their games with the help of AI tools.

Some will work in-person at a San Francisco event space, and there will be daily livestreams with progress updates. The winners in three categories will each receive $7,500, with smaller cash prizes for second and third place winners, as well as additional categories like "best team." Also on the table are "Development Continuation Grants of up to $50,000 per team."

Epic extended the invitation with a reference to The Matrix's 'red pill' scene, presenting red-pilled AI-driven development as an opportunity to "ship awesome games in a weekend," while old-fashioned blue-pilled development would have you "wait months to prototype." The hand offering the red pill features an extra finger, a reference to the common mistake made by AI image generators.
points: Unreal Engine maker Epic Games is running a game jam in November with thousands of dollars in prizes up for grabs.

body: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

Begin your journey in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE in the free demo and experience the story from the opening through the end of Chapter 1. Continue your adventure by carrying over your demo saved data to the full game.

videos.title: Peak - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center.
body: In the game, there’s an important rule: Never abandon a friend in need. Therefore, we’re excited that with the launch on PS5 we’ve also made it possible for crossplay so that you can climb with your friend no matter what platform they use.

The PlayStation 5 port includes all content updates, biomes, and new items the game has gotten since launch - and yes, that includes being able to physically kick your friends using custom runs if you want to be evil. So get your troop together for PEAK on PlayStation 5!

videos.title: Cyberpunk 2077 | Edgerunners 2 Update Features Overview Trailer
videos.summary: The Edgerunners 2 Update is coming on October 22! Check out what’s new in this latest free update for Cyberpunk 2077.
body: Experience new content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, including a new quest set before the events of the anime. Go gung-ho with Dual Wielding, a new playstyle that doubles your firepower with dedicated perks. Customize your cyberware at glamdocs, discover community-made mods with Cross Platform Mod Support, take Night City Tours, and much, much more to discover.

The Edgerunners 2 Update will be available on October 22 on PC, Mac (Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, and coming soon on Nintendo Switch 2 and Mac (Mac App Store version).
